it called the synagogue and the hall of Tyrannus groups of people; they are places, and the verse names the disciples as taken with him

actions.new_text: In Act 19:8 and Act 19:9 the one reasoning is referred to by pronoun only (he); the places are named (the synagogue, the hall of Tyrannus) and the disciples are named as those he took with him; God is named in the kingdom of God, the subject of the reasoning. In 1Cor 13:11 the one who reasoned is I, the speaker who became a man.
actions.checked: Act 19:8 (he entered the synagogue ... about the kingdom of God) and Act 19:9 (took the disciples with him, reasoning daily in the hall of Tyrannus)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it called the synagogue and the hall of Tyrannus groups of people; they are places, and the verse names the disciples as taken with him
